cases.body: Same characters, gathered in a loop instead of a slice.
cases.diff:
--- a/prefix.py
+++ b/prefix.py
@@ -1,2 +1,7 @@
 def prefix(text: str, count: int) -> str:
-    return text[:count]
+    chars = []
+    for index, char in enumerate(text):
+        if index >= count:
+            break
+        chars.append(char)
+    return ''.join(chars)
reasons: mutant: test did not kill its mutant
